basic_details.scholarship_name: Zhejiang University Asian Future Leaders & Chinese Government Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Zhejiang University (Hangzhou, China) in partnership with China Scholarship Council (CSC) and Bai Xian Asia Institute (BXAI - Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program / AFLSP)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Zhejiang University Campuses (Yuquan & Zijingang Campuses, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Wide multidisciplinary coverage: Computer Science and Technology (AI, Computer Graphics, Software Engineering), Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Control Science, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Agriculture and Biotechnology, and Economics/Management.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 120 to 160 fully funded CSC Type B and AFLSP graduate scholarships awarded annually across Zhejiang University
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science, engineering, and agriculture represent a prominent cohort (typically 15 to 25 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 to 3 years for Master degree; 3 to 4 years for PhD degree, subject to annual academic and conduct review

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports in good physical and mental health
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master applicants must be under 35 years of age; PhD applicants must be under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master applicants; Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD applicants with minimum 3.40 / 4.00 CGPA (78%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities like NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, University of the Punjab, UAF, COMSATS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Graduates from top HEC-recognized Pakistani universities with high class rank are competitively prioritized.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Control Engineering, Materials Science, Biotechnology, or Agriculture with solid coursework.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final year graduating students eligible; must provide official provisional certificate of graduation issued by university registrar.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Industry software engineering experience, Kaggle/data science rankings, or academic research projects enhance competitiveness.

english_proficiency.notes: English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Pakistani universities widely accepted for English-taught graduate programs; IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85 strengthens application.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Zero Chinese language requirement for English-taught graduate programs; free Chinese language courses offered as part of curriculum.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: For AFLSP track, candidates demonstrating cross-cultural leadership and commitment to Asian intercultural understanding are preferred.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Chinese government or university scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver (CNY 28,000 to 35,000 / year waived completely for entire normative duration of degree).

admission_application_fee.details: Zhejiang University online application fee (CNY 800) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation in modern international student dormitories at Yuquan or Zijingang campuses; or off-campus living allowance of CNY 700 to 1,000/month.
accommodation.amount: Free campus dormitory (~CNY 1,000 / month value; ~PKR 40,000 / mo)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid by CSC: CNY 3,000/month for Master's students (~PKR 120,000/month); CNY 3,500/month for PhD students (~PKR 140,000/month). For AFLSP scholars, USD 25,000 total package per year.

airfare.details: Travel to Hangzhou and return airfare are self-funded by student.

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 student visa application fee and residence permit medical checkups paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance and Protection Scheme for Foreign Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year covered by CSC/ZJU).

food_allowance.details: Campus dining halls at ZJU provide affordable high-quality meals (~CNY 15 to 25/day; ~PKR 1,000/day).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Research equipment, computing resources, and lab consumables funded by Zhejiang University research grants.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty research funds sponsor international conference registrations and travel for research students.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Hangzhou subway, bus, and shared bicycle transit are self-funded.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite C9 League university: Zhejiang University (Hangzhou, China)
participating_institutions: Zhejiang University - Zijingang Campus (Main Campus / Sciences & AI)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 45 global university (QS World #44, member of elite C9 League in China). Renowned for computer science, robotics, and entrepreneurship.
available_majors: College of Computer Science and Technology: Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Cybersecurity
College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering: Electronic Information, Communication Engineering
College of Control Science and Engineering: Robotics, Automation, Systems Engineering
School of Materials Science and Engineering: Materials Science, Advanced Functional Materials
College of Agriculture and Biotechnology: Plant Protection, Crop Science, Bioinformatics
School of Management & School of Economics: Innovation and Technology Management
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master degree: 2 to 2.5 years; PhD degree: 3.5 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with 3.4+ GPA, prospective professor acceptance letter strongly recommended, 2 recommendation letters, study plan, and transcripts.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence are highly competitive; Agriculture, Biotechnology, and Materials Science offer favorable admission rates for qualified Pakistani candidates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants are strongly advised to contact ZJU faculty supervisors in advance (October to December) to obtain a 'Form for Provisional Acceptance of International Student by ZJU Professor', which elevates candidate priority during scholarship screening.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Zhejiang University International Student Online Application System & CSC Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create account on ZJU International Student portal, submit online application, pay CNY 800 application fee, and simultaneously submit CSC application under ZJU Agency Number (10335).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - December): Review ZJU faculty profiles; contact prospective supervisors with CV, transcripts, and research proposal to secure Form for Provisional Acceptance.
Step 2 (November - January): Create account on ZJU International Student Online Application System (isinfosys.zju.edu.cn); complete personal information and major selection.
Step 3 (December - February): Upload all required documents, pay application fee (CNY 800), and submit ZJU application.
Step 4 (January - February): Submit application on CSC portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) selecting Type B and Zhejiang University Agency Number 10335.
Step 5 (March - April): Departmental admissions committee reviews applications, conducts technical video interviews, and ranks candidates.
Step 6 (May): ZJU International College forwards recommended candidates to CSC and university scholarship committees for final approval.
Step 7 (June - July): Final admission decisions and scholarship awards announced; admission packages (Admission Notice and JW201/JW202) dispatched.
Step 8 (July - August): Apply for Chinese X1 Student Visa at Chinese Embassy/Consulate in Pakistan; book flights to Hangzhou/Shanghai.
Step 9 (Early September): Arrival at ZJU campus in Hangzhou, dormitory check-in, registration, and orientation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated nomination (CSC Type B / AFLSP): Zhejiang University directly evaluates and nominates admitted international students for full scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from Associate Professors or Professors submitted via online portal system or referee upload.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal Statement & Study Plan: Detail academic background, reasons for choosing Zhejiang University, proposed research direction, and post-graduation goals (minimum 1,000 words).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan (1,500 words) describing research background, methodology, experimental objectives, and expected milestones.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing educational history, laboratory skills, programming languages, publications, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Technical video interview (20 to 30 minutes via DingTalk / Zoom) conducted by departmental faculty committee assessing subject fundamentals and research readiness.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85 recommended; English MOI certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC Pakistan attestation required on academic degrees and transcripts, followed by MOFA Pakistan attestation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized English or Chinese translations for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Complete digital submission on ZJU International Student portal and CSC portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least six months beyond program start.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport bio page is scanned clearly.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Bachelor's and/or Master's degree certificates and complete academic transcripts.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by Higher Education Commission (HEC) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive 1,000+ word statement detailing academic background and proposed study plan.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Tailor study plan to specific laboratories and professors at Zhejiang University.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed recommendation letters from Associate Professors or Full Professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be on institutional letterhead with official academic email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Standard Chinese Foreigner Physical Examination Form with hospital stamp, doctor signature, and attached lab reports.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at any recognized government tertiary hospital in Pakistan within 6 months prior to submission.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Police Character Certificate issued within the past 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by local Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS / TOEFL scorecard or English Medium of Instruction certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI certificate signed and stamped by university registrar or controller of examinations.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Form for Provisional Acceptance by ZJU Professor (Optional but Recommended)
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official signed provisional acceptance form from ZJU faculty member.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Strongly enhances probability of securing CSC Type B scholarship nomination.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake for September enrollment; early application before January 15 strongly recommended.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (CGPA, coursework rigor, and academic pedigree of undergraduate/postgraduate institutions)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Prior laboratory experience, thesis quality, publications, and technical skills)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry experience, internships, or academic research assistantships)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity, feasibility, and depth of study plan)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee, prospective faculty supervisor, and ZJU International College Admissions Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Comprehensive evaluation: Applications are evaluated on academic merit, research potential, and professor alignment. Shortlisted candidates undergo online video interview. Admitted students are ranked and nominated for CSC Type B, AFLSP, or ZJU University Scholarships.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 to 3,500 international applicants across all disciplines
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 160 fully funded CSC Type B and AFLSP scholarships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~15.0% (Strong placement for Pakistani engineers, computer scientists, and agronomists)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid academic background, clear research proposal aligned with ZJU lab, 1+ published paper or conference proceeding, and supervisor provisional acceptance.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Control, Agriculture, and Biotechnology from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, Punjab University, UAF, and COMSATS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Russia, Iran, Bangladesh, South Korea

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized recruiters charging high fees for guaranteed ZJU scholarship placement. Zhejiang University conducts admissions directly through its official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Zhejiang University charges a standard application fee of CNY 800 paid directly in the portal. Do not pay fees to unauthorized parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never use educational agencies; direct correspondence with professors and independent applications are evaluated most favorably.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Medical checkup and police clearance attestation in Pakistan (~PKR 20,000 - 30,000).
Hangzhou residence permit and health verification (~CNY 800 to 1,000; ~PKR 32,000 to 40,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: HSK Chinese proficiency is required. (FACT: Most STEM graduate programs at ZJU are completely English-taught).
CLAIM: HEC Pakistan nomination is required for ZJU CSC. (FACT: This is a direct university recommendation track; no HEC nomination needed).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites claim all admitted students receive flights; official CSC policy confirms airfare is not included for university recommendation programs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 and pass the mandatory Annual CSC Scholarship Review conducted every spring.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency on campus and regular participation in laboratory research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual academic review based on coursework grades, research progress, and laboratory advisor report.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under student visa laws; on-campus research and teaching assistantships are allowed with department approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Graduates are free to pursue careers or further studies anywhere in the world or in China upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or return requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminates upon academic failure, withdrawal, or disciplinary expulsion; past disbursed funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university while on CSC scholarship is strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major changes are permitted only within the department subject to approval by the Graduate School and CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship extensions are extremely rare and require special approval from CSC for justified academic delays.
